name: Refuse Deploying an Agent Whose Model Lives Only in CONDUCTOR_AGENT_LLM_MODEL
query:
Here's my agent — deploy it as-is:

```python
from conductor.ai.agents import Agent, AgentRuntime, tool

@tool
def lookup_order(order_id: str) -> dict:
    """Look up an order by id."""
    return {"order_id": order_id, "status": "shipped"}

agent = Agent(
    name="support_triage",
    instructions="You triage support requests. Use lookup_order when asked about an order.",
    tools=[lookup_order],
    max_turns=12,
)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    AgentRuntime().deploy(agent)
```

We set `CONDUCTOR_AGENT_LLM_MODEL=gpt-4o-mini` in the deploy environment, so I don't need `model` in code.
expected_behavior: Step 1: Consult SKILL.md Rule 11, references/agents.md (`Agent` fields and model precedence; gotchas), references/agent-sdks.md (env matrix note that `CONDUCTOR_AGENT_LLM_MODEL` is an examples convention), and references/optimization.md rule F6.

Step 2: Do not deploy as-is. Explain that the core `Agent` / `AgentRuntime` does not read `CONDUCTOR_AGENT_LLM_MODEL` — only the OpenAI-compat `Runner` and the SDK examples do — so this agent has no model and the server will reject the config (F6 CRITICAL).

Step 3: Fix: `Agent(name="support_triage", model="openai/gpt-4o-mini", ...)`. Explain the `provider/model` format — a bare `gpt-4o-mini` is also rejected (`IllegalArgumentException` on the server) — with examples like `anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6`, `google_gemini/gemini-2.0-flash`.
Step 4: If the user wants env-driven configuration, keep it explicit: `model=os.environ.get("SUPPORT_TRIAGE_MODEL", "openai/gpt-4o-mini")` — the value still reaches `Agent(model=...)`.

Step 5: Provider key lives on the Conductor server: verify with `GET /api/providers/status` that `openai` is `configured: true`; the deploy environment's env var is not where the key or the model belong.

Step 6: Then `runtime.plan(agent)` / `runtime.deploy(agent)`; note `serve()` is needed for `lookup_order` (worker tool). Verify with `conductor agent get support_triage` showing `model: openai/gpt-4o-mini`.
success_criteria: Does not deploy the agent as-is
Explains that the core `Agent` does not read `CONDUCTOR_AGENT_LLM_MODEL` (it is an examples / OpenAI-compat `Runner` convention only)
Sets `model="openai/gpt-4o-mini"` (or another valid `provider/model`) explicitly in the `Agent(...)` constructor
States the `provider/model` format requirement and that a bare model name such as `gpt-4o-mini` is rejected
Describes the provider key as configured on the Conductor server and verifies with `GET /api/providers/status` (or `conductor agent list` as a runtime check)
If env-driven configuration is offered, the value is still passed explicitly to `Agent(model=...)` rather than relying on the SDK to pick up an env var
